info.title: Blygger Studio API
info.description: Private authoring and reading API. Protocol files remain a separate public interface.

scopes.owner:read: Read private drafts, reading material, media, and settings
scopes.owner:draft: Create and edit drafts, upload media, and use configured AI generation
scopes.owner:publish: Publish, withdraw, refresh, pin, and change public item responses or media
scopes.owner:manage: Change settings, subscriptions, signals, collections, and response moderation
scopes.reading:state: Mark reading entries read or unread

origin.description: Present for a remote source (0.4, §5.7); omitted for this blyg's own.

url.description: A web page the generator read (decision #117).

entries.description: Copies of the item on other networks, in the owner's order. Spec 0.4 §16.14: the publisher's claim, carried on the live item document only.

url.description: An absolute https: URL at which the copy can be read. Use the most stable URL the network offers.

version.description: The version of the item the copy was made from.

studioTheme.description: The Studio's own palette, reader included: empty (the default) wears the public pages' theme; otherwise auto, a theme name, or custom (the custom palette). Public pages always use theme.

aiModelHelpers.description: The model for text helpers (catch-up-summary); empty, the default, uses the change-notes model.

aiModelClassify.description: The change classifier's decision model (Clef, Jev); empty, the default, is off. Studio-private: a category reaches readers only as words in a changelog note the author confirms.

changeCategoryInNote.description: Lead the changelog note with the classifier's category, in the publish dialog where the author sees it. Matters only while aiModelClassify is set.

changelogDisplay.description: What an item's own public page shows of its changelog: the latest note (the default), every note, or an AI summary of them. A summary is written once per new version with the change-notes model, and is studio-private: it never reaches the item document or the feed.

readerChangelogDisplay.description: The same choice for blyg items in the reader. In summary mode a card shows the latest note and the summary is written when the item is opened.

changelogSummaryPrompt.description: Owner instructions for changelog summaries: the public-page and reader summaries, and a change note drafted with "summarize full history to date".

agenticTitle.description: The owner's name for the Agentic feed tab ("Daily digest", "My briefing"), at most 40 characters; also the heading of each edition's thread. Empty restores "Agentic feed".

readerMarkRead.description: When a reader entry counts as read: seen (on screen about a second while scrolling, the default), opened (its full view), or never (marked by hand only).

readerOrder.description: The Feed tab's order: pace-layered (the default), the home page's order run over everything you read (ROADMAP row 69), or newest first, shown as chronological. Hoppers and Saved keep their own order.

backgroundRules.description: Which Background rules count in the reader, all on by default (blygger-spec docs/background-plan.md). Withdrawn items are always in Background. Reader-only: nothing published changes, and nothing is marked read.

feedOrder.description: The public home page order: an id from feedOrders. pace-layered (the default) and reverse-chronological are core; extensions add orders named <extension>/<id>.

frontPage.description: A published thread's id shown at the mount root instead of the latest items; empty for the latest items. A front page later withdrawn or deleted falls back to the latest items.

postsPath.description: Where the latest items live: {mount}/{postsPath}/, served whether or not a front page is set. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; names the blyg already uses are refused.

linksPosition.description: Where the links section (main menu) sits on public pages: left (the default) or right is a sidebar on wide screens and a Menu button under the masthead on narrow ones; bottom puts it below the content at every width.

linksThreads.description: Published threads listed first in the links section, in order. A thread later withdrawn is left out.

linksExternal.description: The owner's own links in the links section.

linksCollections.description: List public collections in the links section.

linksOpml.description: Link the blogroll's OPML file in the links section, when the blogroll is not empty.

linksBlyggerOrg.description: Link blygger.org in the links section.

linksBlyggerCom.description: Link blygger.com, the directory of blygs, in the links section.

bgFlagDisagreement.description: On by default; matters only while bgInstruction is written. On: an entry whose changelog note claims a typo or minor change while much of its text changed stays in view, marked. Off: the classifier's label decides.

bgInstruction.description: Empty by default. The owner's routing instruction for judging other blygs' changes (decision #96): while set, the classifier also reads each version's changelog note with it, and an entry whose note claims a small change against a large measured one stays in view with a chip saying so. With it empty, notes are never sent.

bgModelImported.description: Off by default: other blygs' new versions are judged by the change classifier (aiModelClassify), one decision-model call each under the AI budget, and a typo or minor label sends the entry to Background with the minor rule. Versions the measured rules settle are not sent; the changelog note never is. Studio-private and reader-only.

hopperFeeds.description: Off by default: an RSS feed per public collection at {mount}/h/{slug}/feed.xml, linked from the collection page, and a hoppers list in blyg.json (spec 0.4 §13.5, decision #86). Publish side only: subscribing to another blyg's hopper works with this off.

setup.description: The setup wizard: pending on a fresh install, notice on a node that published before it existed, done once finished or dismissed.

defaults.description: Read-only: what each setting reads as with nothing stored, for "reset to default". siteTitle's default is the title derived from the address; store "" to keep it derived.

feedOrders.description: Read-only: the home page orders this node can use now (core, plus enabled extensions').

discoverSeenAt.description: Discover: the listing date of the newest blygger.com listing the owner has been shown, ISO; empty until Discover is first opened. Listings after it are new.

extensions.description: Studio extensions enabled on this node (docs/extensions.md). Only names compiled into this build are accepted; every extension starts disabled.

background.description: The owner moved this whole blyg to Background in the reader. An entry's own placement still wins (blygger-spec docs/background-plan.md).

hopperFeedUrl.description: A hopper subscription (one public hopper at another blyg; spec 0.4 §16.12): the hopper feed's resolved absolute URL, which with origin (the blyg's identity origin) is the subscription's identity. Null for every other subscription.

sources.description: Every source that holds a word: "owner" first, then the rest by name.

revision.description: The dictionary's revision. Send it back as expectedRevision for a conditional replace; every successful PUT bumps it.

source.description: "owner" for the words the author adds; any other name for a set an extension or client installed.

words.description: The source's words, sorted without regard to case.

entries.description: The shelved items, in the owner's order, each named as hopper membership names an item. Own drafts may be shelved; a withdrawn own item, or an imported tombstone with no retained pin, is omitted. A discarded draft, an imported item no longer held, and every entry of a deleted subscription leave the shelf. Studio-private for good: never in an item document, feed, manifest or public page, and the shelf never gains a public mode.

revision.description: The shelf's revision. Send it back as expectedRevision for a conditional replace; every successful PUT bumps it.

sub.description: The subscription the item is held under, or "~own" (OWN_SUBSCRIPTION) for one of the owner's own items.

remoteId.description: The item's id: the own item's id under "~own", else the imported item's remote id.

ordered.description: time when every card's time is known; otherwise deeper first (a quote is always of something older), then by time.

sub.description: Where it is held: a subscription id, "~own", or null when this reader does not hold it.

source.description: Whose it is: the subscription name, "you", or the host.

html.description: The post's own words: its layer with every quote inside it taken out, sanitized.

summary.description: A few plain sentences, oldest first: who said what and where the conversation stands. Generated: place it in a thread only as an impyrt span.

sources.description: Every post it read, oldest first, in the §5.9 reference shape (no origin for your own items).

cached.description: True when the same versions were summarized before and nothing was spent.

revision.description: Send it back as expectedRevision for a conditional replace; every successful PUT bumps it. A never-written edition is at 0.

edition.description: The edition as the assistant wrote it (AgenticEditionInput); null before the first PUT.

layout.description: What the tab draws: sections with each reference resolved to its reading entry. A reference that no longer resolves (unsubscribed, discarded, withdrawn) is left out, and a section left empty is dropped.

draft.description: The edition as a conformant blyg thread: a draft (private, owner-only) composed from headings, quotes, links and impyrt spans for the assistant's words, which the owner may edit and publish like any thread. A new draft starts when the owner has edited or published the previous one.

version.description: The version of the item held here. A readVersion below it means a newer version arrived after the owner read it.

readVersion.description: The highest version the owner has marked read; null when unread or cleared.

syndication.description: The origin's `syndication` member (spec 0.4 §16.14) as last fetched, https: entries only: copies the publisher says they made on other networks. The publisher's claim; absent when none.

sub.description: The subscription the part is held under, or "~own".

parts.description: A thread's burst (spec §13.7's fold): the items of its blyg it was first to name, published with it, now in Background as `burst`. Present only on a thread that has them, while the burst rule is on.

ReadingEntry.description: The reading entry the reference resolves to, as GET /reading returns it.

reasons.description: The automatic reasons that count under Settings (withdrawn always), in order: withdrawn, then each enabled rule that applies.

placement.description: The owner's choice on this entry, which beats every rule; null when the rules decide.

blyg.description: The owner moved this entry's whole blyg to Background.

detail.description: What a reason's label says, such as the change category behind minor.

EntryBackground.description: Why the entry is in Background or not (blygger-spec docs/background-plan.md). Reader-only: never published, never marks anything read.

sub.description: The subscription the entry is held under, or "~own" for one of the owner's own items (as Saved names entries).

remoteId.description: The item's id: the own item's id, else the imported item's remote id.

version.description: The version the assistant judged. Shown so a reader can tell when the item has moved on since.

headline.description: A headline for the entry in this edition. Written by the assistant and shown as its own, disclosed as generated.

summary.description: A short summary or dek. Written by the assistant and shown as its own, disclosed as generated.

reason.description: Why the reader is seeing it. Written by the assistant and shown as its own, disclosed as generated.

present.description: How much of the entry to show: the full text, an excerpt (the default), only its title, or folded under its group's first entry.

group.description: Entries in a section with the same group are shown together under the first of them.

title.description: The edition's name, a masthead line. Written by the assistant and shown as its own, disclosed as generated.

lede.description: An opening paragraph for the whole edition. Written by the assistant and shown as its own, disclosed as generated.

name.description: Who wrote the edition: "resident" for the Studio's own assistant, else the outside assistant's name.

model.description: The model it used, when it says.

generatedAt.description: When the assistant made the edition (ISO 8601 UTC).

sections.description: Edition mode: the assistant lays out the sections itself. Send sections or scores, never both.

scores.description: Scores mode: per-entry scores; the Studio lays out one section, highest first. Send sections or scores, never both.

title.description: The section's heading. Written by the assistant.

kind.description: A layout hint: the lead story, an ordinary section (the default), or a column of briefs.

note.description: An introduction to the section. Written by the assistant and shown as its own, disclosed as generated.

sub.description: The subscription the entry is held under, or "~own" for one of the owner's own items (as Saved names entries).

remoteId.description: The item's id: the own item's id, else the imported item's remote id.

score.description: Higher is shown first. Any finite number; only the order matters.

reason.description: Why the reader is seeing it. Written by the assistant and shown as its own, disclosed as generated.

handle.description: The petname typed as @handle. Never leaves the studio.

ids.description: Alternate identifiers. Only self and bound go on the wire; the API can only add entered ones.

syndication.description: The origin's `syndication` member (spec 0.4 §16.14) as last fetched, kept to well-formed https: entries: copies the publisher says they made on other networks. The publisher's claim, never a reason to hide or merge another post. Absent or null when there are none. Fetched with the item document, so an entry added after the held version arrives with the next one.

keySecret.description: The Worker secret holding this provider's key. Absent for a Workers AI provider (it uses `binding`) and for a keyless OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

binding.description: Workers AI only: the Worker binding the provider calls (studio#8).

configured.description: The key secret is set, the binding is bound, or the provider needs neither.

kind.description: A decision model (Clef, Jev): offered only for the change classifier (aiModelClassify), never for text generation.

visible.description: Verified, unhidden responses before the target item response policy is applied. `link` notices are never responses (spec 0.4 §15.5) and are not counted.

links.description: Verified `link` notices: other blygs linking to the target. Counted in total, never in visible.

verifiedAt.description: Latest verifiedAt with SQL NULL coalesced to an empty string.

lastSeen.description: Latest lastSeen among receipts tied at the group verifiedAt.

firstId.description: Smallest receipt id among receipts tied at both group timestamps.

version.description: The version of the item held here. A readVersion below it means a newer version arrived after the owner read it.

readVersion.description: The highest version the owner has marked read; null when unread or cleared.

syndication.description: The origin's `syndication` member (spec 0.4 §16.14) as last fetched, https: entries only. Null when none.

contentMd.description: The item's markdown as imported; empty for a withdrawn item and for feeds that carry none.

page.description: The origin's declared page, as the origin declared it; null when it declares none.

thumb.description: The owner's signal; null when none.

hoppers.description: Ids of the hoppers holding this item.

transclusions.description: The origin's transclusions[] verbatim (Transclusion shape, cited included); remote and unvalidated. Null for fragments, L0 items, withdrawn items, or malformed data.

stubOf.description: The origin's stub_of verbatim (CitationTarget shape); remote and unvalidated. Null when none.

forkedFrom.description: The origin's forked_from verbatim (VersionReference shape); remote and unvalidated. Null when none.

generated.description: The origin's generated[] verbatim (GenerationProvenance shape, remote sources' origin and cited included); remote and unvalidated. Null when none.

contentHtml.description: Sanitized, as a subscribed item's is.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription holding this origin, when there is one: open the held copy at /reading/{sub}/{id}.

find.description: Text from the draft, exactly, holding the error and a little context.

why.description: A few words on what is wrong.

cjk.description: Han, kana and Hangul characters, counted one by one.
Han, kana and Hangul characters, counted one by one.

items.description: Items in the outline tree, this one included.

document.description: The roll-up over this side's outline links; null when they do not form a strict tree of our own items.

published.description: The current published version, and the tree its outline makes; null for an item never published.

draft.description: The working copy as publish would bake it now, and the tree its outline makes. Equal to `published` when there are no unpublished edits.

tangle.description: Confirms publishing the new items a thread's `![[+ text]]` spans make. Without it, a working copy with spans gets 409 tangle-confirmation-required, listing them in details.parts and their number in details.count, and nothing is written.

changeCategory.description: The change category the author confirmed in the publish dialog: kept with the version in studio-private storage (never on the wire). Omitted: a classification made for these words stands; null: cleared.

unresolvedHandles.description: @words that name no contact. They stay literal text.

parts.description: Items this publish made from the thread's `![[+ text]]` spans, or finished making, in source order. Each was published before the thread.

version.description: The version the working copy would publish as.

category.description: Null when no category could be had; see reason.

model.description: The decision model that answered; null for refresh, decided locally from content_hash.

reason.description: Why there is no category: a provider error, an exhausted AI budget, or an unusable answer. Never fatal: publish as usual.

history.description: Summarize the item's whole revision history to date, ending with this change, from the earlier notes and the two texts; longer than a plain note (at most 400 characters). Off by default.

schema.description: An own item by itemId, or an imported blyg item by its subscription and remote id. The summary reads the changelog's notes only, is written once per version with the change-notes model and kept, and is studio-private.

proceed.description: Generate even if some links in the draft could not be read.

total.description: Links found in the instruction and the draft.

failed.description: Links that could not be read, and why.

checkpoint.description: Nothing was generated: some links could not be read. Send `proceed: true` to generate without them (decision #117).

expectedRevision.description: Required: the item's revision, as for a pin. A replace bumps it.

post.description: Attaching new media to a published item also requires owner:publish. Returning an existing duplicate does not.

patch.description: Choosing avatarMediaId also requires owner:publish because the avatar publishes those bytes.

words.description: The source's whole word list (at most 20000); replaces what it held. An empty list removes the source. A word is 1 to 64 characters with no whitespace and at least one letter, kept as written (names keep their capitals); one that isn't is refused with 400, naming it. Repeats are kept once.

expectedRevision.description: Required. Replace only if the dictionary is still at this revision (read it with GET /dictionary; a never-written dictionary is at 0); otherwise 409 revision-conflict with the current dictionary in details.current.

entries.description: The whole list, in order (at most 50). Replaces the stored list. An entry that does not resolve (an unknown subscription, an item not held under it, a withdrawn own item, an imported tombstone with no retained pin) is dropped quietly, never refused, and a repeated entry keeps its first position; the response is what was stored.

expectedRevision.description: Required. Replace only if the shelf is still at this revision (read it with GET /shelf; a never-written shelf is at 0); otherwise 409 revision-conflict with the current { entries, revision } in details.current. There is no unconditional replace: several clients share the shelf, and one must not silently undo another's reorder.
